Completions and signature help. ‸ marks the cursor.

=== members of a class, private ones only inside it
-- script/main --
class Bag {
  size = 0
  private secret = 1
  add(n: number): void {}
  private hide(): void {}
}
export function main(): void {
  const b = new Bag()
  b.‸
}
-- completions --
+ size
+ add
- secret
- hide
- length

=== signature help in a call
-- script/main --

export function main(): string { return mix(1, ‸) }

=== signature help for a method and a constructor
-- script/main --
